_note: Nine steps, numbered 0 to 8, matching docs/agent-native/install-order.md. fences lists which fenced code blocks of that step's section to copy verbatim. A step with no stated command says so. build-site.mjs fails if the step count differs from the table in install-order.md.

steps.title: Toolchain
steps.why: Node >=24.3.0, pnpm 12.18.0, Rust with cargo, Xcode for Apple, Android NDK and cargo-ndk for Android.
steps.source: CI runs these two on Node 24 (.github/workflows/ignition-v1-integration.yml). rustup targets and cargo-ndk have no stated install command.

steps.title: @nitro-forge/ignition native host
steps.why: Native module, Nitrogen output and the Rust archives. shadcn cannot run nitrogen, pod install or CMake.

steps.title: An engine package, for example @nitro-forge/tally
steps.why: Workspace dependency. Every engine is in the one Rust archive from step 1.
steps.source: A line in the app's package.json. apps/example/package.json lists all of them.

steps.title: @nitro-forge/studio-layout
steps.why: Private, pure TypeScript, no build step. Needed for the Studio type and the dock model.
steps.source: A line in the app's package.json. No tarball exists.

steps.title: @nitro-forge/icons through item forge-icon
steps.why: Copies the icon source and adds react-native-svg when it is missing.
steps.source: Run against a local server only. The GitHub URL needs a release tag.

steps.title: NYC-Tron tarballs
steps.why: GitHub release assets, pinned in tooling/nyc-tron.json. The packages cannot be installed by shadcn. Registry items that wrap them can.
steps.source: Exact URLs and sha256 values are in tooling/nyc-tron.json.

steps.title: Theme CSS
steps.why: NYC-Tron ships no colours. The generated CSS declares the variables its components read.
steps.source: The add copies theme.ts, theme.css and theme.native.css. The CSS entry import is app code (install-order.md step 6).

steps.title: StudioUIProvider and host
steps.why: Every studio component throws at first render without the provider.
steps.source: Wiring the 27 slots is app code. See apps/example/src/studio-ui.tsx.

steps.title: Studio components
steps.why: Only now do the studio chrome items work.
steps.source: Other items are listed on the home page.
